answer: Attestation weight is reciprocity-weighted: a vote counts in proportion to how much independent work the voter has already had graded by others, and a panel whose members share a cluster is void before it scores. Because payouts vest against future work, a farm that pushes a nadir of junk answers through a trellis of linked voters ends up holding credit it cannot spend, and every new wharf of clones adds locked stake without adding weight.
